item.problem_title: No decomposition separates scientific-target mismatch from protocol compromise, mapping loss and estimation error
item.problem_statement: Three trials are in play in any emulation and only one is usually named: the ideal trial that would answer the decision-maker's question, the target trial the investigator specifies, and the emulation the data support. Specifying the target trial closely around the available data conceals the distance between the first two, and the paper reports one estimate as though the chain were tight. What is missing is not an additive decomposition; that generally does not exist, because the transitions change populations, interventions, outcomes and scales, so the discrepancies do not add. What is missing is a documented lineage: the change from the decision question to the operational causal estimand, the assumptions mapping that estimand to an observed-data functional, and the estimation uncertainty, each recorded separately so a reader can see which step carries the load. item.problem_title: Negative controls, proxies and validation data are not integrated into a standard emulation workflow
item.problem_statement: A correctly implemented emulation prevents specific design-induced temporal biases and does not create exchangeability. Active-comparator new-user designs, high-dimensional propensity scores and richer clinical measurement all reduce residual confounding without guaranteeing it. The tools that address what remains, negative control outcomes and exposures, instrumental variables, proximal causal learning and external validation samples, identify under distinct and partly untestable assumptions and sometimes target different estimands. They therefore cannot be mechanically ordered or combined: doing so requires an explicit joint model aligned to one estimand, and no such model is in use, so there is no convention for reporting what each tool contributed or for reconciling them when they disagree. item.problem_title: Code, phenotype logic, weight diagnostics and rejected protocol versions are not available for emulations
item.problem_statement: The TARGET statement asks for the target protocol, its data mapping, the estimands, the assumptions, the estimates and the sensitivity analyses, and is a transparency instrument rather than a risk-of-bias certification. An emulation is not externally auditable when its final analysis code, its complete versioned phenotype logic and its weight diagnostics are unavailable, and in current practice they are: most emulations are irreproducible in operative detail despite faithful protocol reporting. Where the real data cannot be shared, code plus a documented schema, a container and synthetic fixtures establishes that the pipeline executes and what it does; it does not reproduce the published estimate, and auditability rather than reproduction is what such a release can deliver. Material protocol amendments belong in a versioned decision log, which nothing currently requires.

item.problem_statement: An emulated protocol has to fix three times that a randomized trial fixes in one act, when eligibility is assessed, when treatment is assigned, and when follow-up begins, and it has to fix the resolution at which time is measured, because routine data arrive as dated records rather than as scheduled visits. Clone-censor-weight and sequential emulation handle the misalignment; neither chooses the grace period or the interval width, and estimates move with both. A coarse interval lets treatment affect an outcome inside the interval before censoring applies; a fine interval produces high-dimensional nuisance models and unstable weights. item.problem_title: Positivity diagnostics describe weights instead of naming which patient histories are unsupported
item.problem_statement: A deterministic treatment strategy can assign a treatment that clinicians almost never give to patients with certain covariate histories. The standard response is to inspect the weight distribution and truncate the tail. Truncation is bias-variance regularization: it cannot identify an effect where the treatment density is structurally zero, and a marginal weight summary does not say which intervention-relevant histories carry small or zero density. What a reader needs and does not get is a policy-specific support criterion fixed in advance, diagnostics localized by time and by history, the fraction of the target population that fails the criterion, and the estimand that survives once those strata are set aside. Empirically, poor overlap has been shown to defeat adjustment methods that were otherwise well specified, which is the failure a weight histogram is least able to show. Software

item.problem_title: Emulation assumes no interference, and cloning individuals can produce joint strategies nobody could implement
item.problem_statement: One person's treatment can change another's outcome through infection, provider behavior, household exposure or a shared resource constraint. Target trial emulation as normally practiced invokes no interference, and under that assumption an individual-level protocol is coherent. Identifying a direct or spillover effect requires more than adding the interference literature alongside it: the emulation has to specify a feasible joint or stochastic treatment policy, the exposure mapping or potential-outcome indexing that defines what each unit is exposed to, and joint support for that exposure. Individual clone-censor rules do not identify those effects, because a set of individually compatible strategies need not correspond to any allocation a cluster could receive. item.paper: Adjacent spillover efficacy of Wolbachia for control of dengue: emulation of a cluster randomised target trial.
item.evidence: Interference is not assumed away here, it is the estimand: the contrast is between residents of untreated sectors adjacent to release sites and residents of untreated towns, giving 45% protective efficacy against up to 77% measured inside release sites in prior work on the same design. That converts a no-interference assumption into a measured quantity for one adjacency ring. What it does not close is the rest of the interference structure: adjacency is binary and geographic, control towns are assumed wholly unexposed with no distance-graded estimate, and the individual-level joint strategy question does not arise because the assignment unit is a sector.
